_doc: Rebuild data for YP_bouwnummer_25.pdf (Type R3.sp). Phase 1 extracted dimensions from the PDF; Phase 2 renders this to floorplan/floorplan.svg (tools/render-floorplan.py); Phase 3 builds the 3D model (APARTMENT_GEOM in index.html) and verifies it against the PDF's own vector lines with tools/compare-to-pdf.py. As of the latest fidelity pass every model wall lies on a PDF wall slab within 0.12 m (centreline vs slab face), including all diagonal chamfers; see phase3_model_fidelity.

phase3_model_fidelity.tool: tools/compare-to-pdf.py (model walls + diagonals vs the PDF's own vector lines)
phase3_model_fidelity.status: PASS - every axis-aligned wall matches a PDF line within 0.12 m (columns: centreline-vs-face 0.25 m by construction). Door positions AND swing directions were re-read from the PDF's door-arc polylines (2025-09 realism pass).
resolved: NW corner rebuilt: the long chamfer runs (-1.33,2.12)->(1.92,3.95) (NOT to (0,4.10) as before); the tip is a stepped zigzag with a small interior pier, with a window (inner face z=0.21) at x 0.71..1.58.
Slaapkamer 1 (23.45 m2) includes an entry alcove x 1.92..3.76, z 4.21..4.87; its door is in the z=4.87..4.96 plane at x 2.67..3.60. Its south wall z=4.21..4.30 only spans x 3.76..5.59.
Installatieschacht (X-hatched trapezoid) walled between chamfer-2, the entry and the technische berging: north z=4.86..4.96 (x 1.92..2.56), east x=2.46..2.56, south z=5.61..5.71.
Technische berging (WTW/boiler/WM/CD) added west of the gang: x 0.19..2.46, z 5.71..7.14, door on its east wall; boiler closet + WM/CD niche south of it (z 7.14..7.92).
Badkamer (8.06 m2) south wall is at z=7.04..7.14 (was 6.85). Berging/toilet band z 7.14..8.07: berging x 3.86..4.75 (880 mm), toilet x 4.84..6.63 (1785 mm), mini-shaft x 6.64..6.94.

Slaapkamer 2 (18.90 m2) is 0.65 m deeper than before: facade inner face z=15.41 (3900 mm from the en-suite wall), window piers + recessed schuifpui x 1.68..3.45 at z=15.68..15.79, SW diagonal (0.19,14.85)->(1.15,15.41).
West facade slab -0.06..0.19 (inner face x=0.19, was modelled at x=0).
North facade: slaapk1 schuifpui x 1.58..5.18, woonkamer window band x 5.18..6.98 (inner face z=0.21), woonkamer schuifpui x 7.04..10.53.
Balconies: noord railing z=-1.08 spanning x 1.74..10.74 with a curved west end into the tip; zuid railing z=17.55..17.67 spanning x 3.10..10.74 with a large curved SW corner to the facade diagonal.
Second chamfer (1.69,4.23)->(0.24,6.74) is the wall to the stair core. The x=1.92 piece z 3.95..4.87 is SOLID (X-hatched shaft void behind it) - it is NOT the voordeur.
VOORDEUR: in the WEST party wall of the gang, z 8.03..8.96 (PDF arc (0.14,8.96)->(1.07,8.03): hinge north, swings east into the gang). The gemeenschappelijke corridor lies west of x=-0.06.

Badkamer klein (3.81 m2) is WEST (x 0.19..2.54, z 9.64..11.41) and is entered from the slaapkamer-2 nook through its EAST wall, door z 10.32..11.25 (hinge north, swings east). Its north wall to the gang is solid.
Gang -> woonkamer: door z 8.58..9.51 (hinge north, swings east into the woonkamer) with a fixed glass zijlicht z 8.17..8.55 north of it.

Technische berging door z 6.16..7.09 (hinge north, swings east). Closet band: boiler closet x 0.19..1.00 and vloerverwarmingsverdeler closet x 1.06..1.73 (z 7.31..7.81) with doors to the gang; WM/CD niche x 1.80..2.46 open to the berging.

Small berging (880 mm) opens WEST into the gang (door z 7.19..8.02, hinge north); its south wall is solid. Badkamer door z 5.45..6.38 hinges south and swings west; slaapk1 door hinges east and swings north; toilet door hinges west and swings south; slaapk2 nook door x 2.79..3.72 hinges east and swings south.
North facade x 0.71..1.58 and x 5.18..6.98 are SOLID (filled) facade, not windows.

Structural columns (existing concrete frame): slaapk1 x 5.08..5.59 z 0.71..1.28; badkamer x 5.04..5.60 z 6.40..7.04; keukenbaai x 5.08..5.58 z 14.40..14.90 (free-standing); ZO-penant x 10.25..11.01 z 13.60..15.80 (projects onto the south balcony).

Balcony curves bulge OUTWARD: north railing curves to (0.30,-1.31) and returns to the facade at (-0.10,-0.42); south railing curves from (3.12,17.55) to (1.80,17.96) then runs straight to the facade diagonal at (0.66,16.01).
Plafondhoogte (Technische Omschrijving): 2.80 m, badkamers en verkeersruimten 2.55 m (model.json rooms.ceil).

The shared corridor west of the voordeur is indicative (the sales drawing stops at the party wall).
The NW tip facet (0.71,0.21)->(-0.12,0.02) and the entry filler wall are drawn as filled wall mass in the PDF (no stroked centreline); their positions come from the raster image.

Toilet = 0.93 × 1.785 = 1.660 m² ≈ 1.67 m² (user-confirmed). The 880 callout is NOT the toilet width; it's likely a berging/fixture dim.

nw_zigzag._doc: Inner-face outline of the NW corner, traced from the PDF's vector lines (w=0.7/1.0 wall faces). From the north-facade window (x 0.71..1.58, inner z=0.21) the boundary steps NW past z=0, down the small facets to the 1397 mm facet, then the long chamfer descends SE to (1.92,3.95) where the voordeur wall begins. A small triangular pier (edges z=0.71, x=0.19 and the (0.13,1.31)->(-0.61,0.88) diagonal) pokes into the room.
